GameProfile.title: GameProfile
GameProfile.description: Tracks the AI agent's adaptive difficulty tier, win/loss metrics, and learned heuristic weights for a specific mobile game.

difficultyLevel.description: Current adaptive difficulty level from 1 to 10.

autoAdjustDifficulty.description: Whether the AI automatically adjusts difficulty based on win/loss ratio.

targetWinRate.description: Target optimal learning win rate percentage (30 to 90).

totalWins.description: Total matches won by the AI agent.

totalLosses.description: Total matches lost by the AI agent.

recentOutcomes.description: Bounded sliding window of up to 10 recent match outcomes ('win' or 'loss').

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved by the AI in this game.

aggressionWeight.description: Learned heuristic weight for aggressive scoring moves (0 to 100).

defenseWeight.description: Learned heuristic weight for defensive survival and space preservation (0 to 100).

lookaheadWeight.description: Learned heuristic weight for multi-step board planning (0 to 100).

trapAwarenessWeight.description: Learned heuristic weight for hazard and mistake avoidance (0 to 100).

lastAdjustmentReason.description: Explanation of the most recent adaptive difficulty calibration.

ResearchDoc.title: ResearchDoc
ResearchDoc.description: Pre-game research briefing synthesized from game wikis, strategy guides, or video transcripts.

sourceTitle.description: Title of the wiki, strategy guide, or transcript source.

sourceType.description: Category of the external research material.

rawContent.description: Raw excerpt from the wiki, guide, or video transcript.

keyObjectives.description: Bounded list of core game objectives learned during research.

tacticalRules.description: Bounded list of actionable decision rules extracted from the research.

aggressionBoost.description: Recommended adjustment to aggression weight (-50 to 50).

defenseBoost.description: Recommended adjustment to defense weight (-50 to 50).

lookaheadBoost.description: Recommended adjustment to lookahead weight (-50 to 50).

trapAwarenessBoost.description: Recommended adjustment to trap awareness weight (-50 to 50).

StateMemory.title: StateMemory
StateMemory.description: Episodic state-action-outcome memory entry queried by the AI during gameplay to repeat winning patterns and avoid past mistakes.

stateSignature.description: Canonical encoded board/grid state key for fast similarity lookup.

stateDescription.description: Human-readable description of the board state.

actionTaken.description: Action or move executed in this state.

scoreDelta.description: Immediate score change resulting from the action.

outcome.description: Resulting classification of the state-action transition.

qValueScore.description: Learned utility value (-100 to 100) guiding future decisions in this state.

lessonLearned.description: Corrective rule or strategic insight retained from this state-action outcome.

difficultyLevel.description: Difficulty level (1 to 10) at which this memory was recorded.

timesRecalled.description: Number of times the AI has queried and applied this memory in subsequent matches.

MatchEpisode.title: MatchEpisode
MatchEpisode.description: Completed match telemetry log recording performance metrics, memory hits, mistakes avoided, and adaptive difficulty calibration.

difficultyLevel.description: Difficulty tier played during the match (1 to 10).

finalScore.description: Final score achieved in the match.

memoriesRecalled.description: Number of times stored state-action memories informed decisions.

mistakesAvoided.description: Number of times negative state memories prevented repeating a past mistake.

mistakesCommitted.description: Number of suboptimal or penalized actions committed.

difficultyDelta.description: Adaptive difficulty adjustment triggered after this match (-2 to 2).

aiReflection.description: Post-match AI autopsy and learning synthesis.

/users/{userId}/game_profiles/{gameId}.description: Per-user AI agent profile, heuristic weights, and adaptive difficulty state for each game.

/users/{userId}/research_docs/{docId}.description: Per-user pre-game research briefings synthesized from wikis, guides, and transcripts.

/users/{userId}/match_episodes/{episodeI.description: Per-user match history and adaptive difficulty progression log.
